label: Diagram 8
caption: Diagram 8 Measuring storey and wall heights | E R SBUILDINGS | ION | A1/2
description: This is a section drawing through a house, titled "Diagram 8 Measuring storey and wall heights", with "See para 2C18" in a box at the top left. It shows a gable roof with its ridge at the top centre, a wall under the left roof slope on the left and, on the right, a wall under the right roof slope that is built up with a parapet at its top right. Horizontal slabs divide each wall into floors; on the right the storey heights between the slabs are each marked "2.7m max." Vertical dimension lines on the far left read, top to bottom, D, C, B and A, with B1 alongside C and A1 alongside A; at the base appear the labels "Base of wall (see note)" (written vertically on the left), "Ground level" (centre) and "Top of foundation" (bottom centre). Internal labels point to the "Underside of roof joist", "Line of lateral support to gable at ceiling level", "Line of lateral support to gable wall along roof slope", "Line of base of gable" and "Line of top of gable". On the right, vertical dimension lines H1, H2 and H3 run down to the base of the wall from the level marked "Top of wall or base of parapet", while a short line Hp at the top right measures the parapet above that level. Below the drawing a key defines the letters under the headings (a) Measuring storey heights and (b) Measuring wall heights.
